refreshToken.description: Ring refresh token used to access the camera.

cameraName.description: Name of the Ring camera to monitor.

snapshotDirectory.description: Directory used to save snapshots and latest.jpg.

retentionDays.description: Days to retain saved snapshots before automatic cleanup.

motionResetSeconds.description: Motion reset time used for temporary motion events.

snapshotRetries.description: Number of retries when the Ring snapshot request fails temporarily.

snapshotRetryDelayMs.description: Delay in milliseconds between snapshot retry attempts.

snapshotOnMotion.description: Capture a snapshot whenever motion is detected.

snapshotOnDoorbell.description: Capture a snapshot when the doorbell is pressed.

enableSnapshotTrigger.description: Enable a switch to manually trigger snapshot capture.
